summary: Full backend + frontend verification of iteration 61 (credits system + rent-comparables + grouped tools). All 8 backend pytests pass and all 7 frontend review items verified green on mobile 390 and desktop 1440. Demo user left on basic plan with credit_log cleaned for current period.
critical_code_review_comments: credits.charge raises HTTPException(402) with a plain-string detail; frontend api.ts only fires the credit listener when `typeof data.detail === 'string'`. During simulation, returning `{detail: '...'}` triggered the modal correctly — confirms contract. No change needed.

rent_comps.py performs postcode -> admin_district lookup via api.postcodes.io for every call (even for identical postcode). The in-memory react-query cache (staleTime 1h) protects client-side, but back-to-back API calls from a different client still hit postcodes.io. Low priority; data is small and public.

quick-actions.ts still filters 'rent' alongside the money-gated tools (`['ai','brrr','report','receipt','sold','epc','rent']`). This means stakeholder/co-owner viewers (money hidden) cannot see Rent comps either — expected but worth confirming vs product intent since Rent comps is informational and does not surface money of the owner's project.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backend tests seeded transient credit_log docs for exhaustion scenarios and cleaned them up. Final cleanup also executed via mongo to remove any demo credit_log in the current period.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via UI uses testIDs auth-email-input and auth-password-input then the 'Sign in' text button; the preview URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. The credits-prompt modal is mounted in the root layout and listens via onOutOfCredits — to simulate without exhausting the real allowance, monkey-patch window.fetch to return 402 with a JSON body `{detail: '...'}`. In Mongo, credit_log stores user_id as the string _id of users (not the uuid id); when inserting via the pytest fixture, use /api/auth/me which returns the correct id field consumed by the backend. The backend `used_this_month` aggregation matches on the uuid style user.id so the pytest flow works end-to-end.
